_comment: Slack app manifest for the VTO Documents Manager bot. Create at https://api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From an app manifest -> pick the Vto-Agentic workspace -> paste this JSON. Then: Install to Workspace, copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-) into config/.secrets.env as SLACK_BOT_DOCSMANAGER, remove the docsmanager entry from LLM_POST_BOT in apps/daemon/src/daemon.ts, rebuild, and invite @VTO-DocsManager to #swarm-docs and #swarm-admin (or run swarmctl bootstrap invite).

display_information.name: VTO DocsManager
display_information.description: Session ledger, context handoff, compaction watch for the VTO swarm
